editorial_focus: Handheld gaming, controller-first experiences, readable gameplay and useful purchase guidance
rules: Every production clip requires documented commercial and derivative-use permission before rendering.
Vertical versions use full-screen action crops, not a small landscape window with empty space.
Each platform gets its own edit, narration, CTA, safe areas and thumbnail.
No FPS, battery-life, compatibility or performance claims without current source evidence or real measurement.
Every final video requires owner review before publication.
